title: The batch runner's working state lives in one file on branch roadmap that it rewrites at each merge and re-reads at start and after compaction
why: Owner 22:47 CST Nov 13 (relayed): the batch runner seemed to have amnesia after compaction. Third cause, by the consultant: its working state (merge queue order, train batches and members, gos, holds with their end events, archive pass) lives only in its handoff.
note: Triage 22:48 CST Nov 13: one file on branch roadmap (the wave plan or a sibling file) that the runner rewrites at each merge and re-reads at start and after compaction; its handoff points to the file and never copies the list (handoff prompt step 4: "name the home and never copy the list"). Open problem, runner 10's own words earlier tonight (relayed): it cannot push to the record branch. Options for the lane to weigh: the runner sends the state to triage, who commits it (a per-merge message); or the runner is given push access to roadmap by its own grant. Neither is chosen. Not started; the coordinator assigns a lane. Needs a past-ruling and guard-record read first.
